struck: PointAddress means the finder put the point on the rooftop.
use: PointAddress means the finder matched one of the county's own address points.

struck: At a condo building, one point returns every unit's parcel stacked on the same footprint.
use: At a condo building, one point returns the unit parcels drawn on the building's outline, plus one common-area parcel.

struck: The county's address points layer ties each address to a PIN.
use: Nearly every address on the county's address map carries a parcel number (PIN).

struck: About 9 in 10 Horry County parcels carry a deed book and page.
use: Nearly 9 in 10 Horry County parcels carry a deed book and page.

struck: The tax search cannot be filled in by a link.
use: A link opens the county's tax search with the parcel number already searched.

pattern: \b(?:7 in 10|seven in ten|1 in 3|one in three|3 in 4|three in four)\b[^.]{0,60}\b(?:homes|houses|properties|parcels|lots)\b
struck: About 7 in 10 Horry County homes are outside every city and town.
use: About 7 in 10 street addresses in Horry County are outside every city and town.

struck: Zone AE: high risk. A lender will require flood insurance.
use: Zone AE: high risk. A federally regulated or federally backed mortgage requires flood insurance on the building.

struck: Horry County has 12 certified floodplain managers who answer flood map questions at (843) 915-5090.
use: Horry County Code Enforcement has 12 certified floodplain managers on staff. To reach one, call its flood office at (843) 915-5090.

struck: The county's open parcel layer holds about 302,600 parcels.
use: Horry County's map holds more than 300,000 parcels.

struck: The deed index searches by name, last name first, no punctuation.
use: The deed index searches by name: type the last name first, then the first name.

struck: The county map searches by address, owner, PIN or TMS after a free county sign-in.
use: The county map searches by address, owner, PIN or TMS after you sign in with a county account. The sign-up form has no payment step.
